{{Quote|This superconductive ma­terial is worn by the Brothers of Barbeen, among others.|Jedi Master Skarch Vaunk, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Brothers of Barbeen''' was a group<ref name="TJP" /> that shared its name with the [[Barbeen system/Legends|Barbeen system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Its members wore [[Ultrachrome/Legends|ultrachrome]], a superconductive<ref name="TJP" /> metal<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> that was resistant to the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] blades of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the signature weapon of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. That fact was noted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Skarch Vaunk]] in a chapter of the<ref name="TJP" /> [[990 BBY]]<ref name="TJP" /><ref name="JPEndnotes1">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)}}</ref> [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Brothers of Barbeen were created by [[Daniel Wallace]] for the [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']].<ref name="TJP" />
